title: Context Menu Icon Resolution
description: Fix places where context menu icons show raw shortcode strings instead of rendered icons (e.g. puzzle 3d sparkles, trash).
summary: Fixed context menu icons showing raw shortcode strings. `renderContextMenuIcon` now always routes through `Icon`. `coerceIconSource` resolves emoji/catalog shortcodes and maps `trash` → `trash-2`. Vendored Lucide `sparkles` icon added to the catalog. Puzzle 2d/3d delete menu uses `trash-2`. Test covers trash/sparkles/copy menu icons.
